headline: Profitability rebounds as credit costs ease
summary_short: Capital One reported Q2 FY2026 net income of $3.02B ($4.73 diluted EPS), up 38.9% q/q, as revenue grew 4.1% to $15.85B and provision for credit losses fell $1.1B to $3.0B on a $662M reserve release.
summary_long: Revenue rose 4.1% q/q and 26.9% y/y to $15.85B. Net income of $3.02B (+38.9% q/q) reversed a $4.28B net loss a year earlier; diluted EPS was $4.73 (adjusted $5.81 excluding $0.60/share acquisition amortization, $0.36 Discover integration, and $0.12 Brex integration costs). Net interest margin widened 14bp to 8.01%; efficiency ratio was 57.05% (51.38% adjusted). Provision for credit losses fell $1.1B to $3.0B, including a $662M reserve release against $3.6B of net charge-offs. Non-interest expense rose 7% on higher marketing and operating costs. Period-end deposits fell 1% to $484.3B; loans held for investment rose 2% to $457.2B. CET1 ratio was a preliminary 13.7%. No forward guidance was issued in the release.
